Dynamic review values use textContent/createElement; no new HTML injection sink, persistence, external request, credentials or remote dependency.

Unacknowledged, cancelled, expired, silently edited or repeated confirmation cannot use this handler to POST stale review; signature includes current FormData, action/method and pricing/payout source objects.

Recipient address/network/tag or payout details displayed with indicative fees, executor, custody, external identity rules and irreversible-transfer caveat; SELL explicitly defers deposit instructions to created order.
Native modal, associated labels, focus restoration, Escape cancellation and Tab wrap present. Initial disabled submit plus onsubmit=false fail closed if review script unavailable.

Apply publishes include before parent templates; rollback restores parents before removing include. Helper binds source/live hashes and service identities, preserves metadata, fsyncs durable backups before mutation and fsyncs atomic replacements.
Rehearsal code exercises candidate/unrelated/metadata/runtime drift, corrupted backup, partial apply after each first/second file, rollback removal of new include and reconcile.
